items.information:

🇧🇷  **Note que este campeonato possui APENAS modalidades silenciosas!**

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada por meio da plataforma Stripe - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentBrasilia2023/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cJNjPk_J4M).

Competidores participando pela primeira vez são obrigados a apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, gênero, data de nascimento e nacionalidade.

Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes do evento, em especial os artigos específicos das modalidades da competição.

--------------------

🇺🇸  **Please note that this competition has ONLY silent events!**

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance through Stripe - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentBrasilia2023/register) tab. If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cJNjPk_J4M).

Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, gender, date of birth and nationality.

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition, especially the specific articles of the competition events.

items.name: Ajax 3x3x3 Morning 2023

venue.name: [Ajax Community Centre - HMS Community Hall](https://facilities.ajax.ca/Home/Detail?Id=db52c417-b7aa-40fe-8939-61304512694f)

items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## Ajax 3x3x3 Series 2023

One day, three competitions! We are running three competitions as part of Ajax 3x3x3 Series 2023: [morning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Morning2023), [afternoon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Afternoon2023) and [evening](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Evening2023)!

You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these three competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***

This is a great opportunity to compete in 3x3x3 Cube – the maximum-allowed top-75% of competitors will advance to the second round!

### Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:
All additional donations and remaining profits from this competition will be donated to the [Associated Students of the University of California (ASUC)](https://asuc.org/). 

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbUZFIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e52c4976630111f390c1af58937b15308aa64a13/image.png)

Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may only bring one guest maximum.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
